sql.value: select id, user_id, opus_id, episode_key, position_ms, duration_ms, watched_ms, is_completed, session_id, seq, create_time, update_time from ani_user_opus_progress where user_id = :userId and opus_id = :opusId and episode_key = :episodeKey

select id, user_id, opus_id, episode_key, position_ms, duration_ms, watched_ms, is_completed, session_id, seq, create_time, update_time from ani_user_opus_progress where user_id = :userId and opus_id = :opusId and is_deleted = 0

select auo.opus_id as opusId, ao.name_cn as nameCn, ao.cover_url as coverUrl, auo.last_episode_key as episodeKey, auo.last_media_id as mediaId, auo.last_read_time as lastReadTime, (select p.position_ms from ani_user_opus_progress p where p.user_id = auo.user_id and p.opus_id = auo.opus_id and p.episode_key = auo.last_episode_key and p.is_deleted = 0 limit 1) as positionMs, (select p.duration_ms from ani_user_opus_progress p where p.user_id = auo.user_id and p.opus_id = auo.opus_id and p.episode_key = auo.last_episode_key and p.is_deleted = 0 limit 1) as durationMs, (select m.display_name from ani_media m where m.opus_id = auo.opus_id and m.episode_key = auo.last_episode_key and m.is_deleted = 0 and m.is_primary = 1 order by m.id limit 1) as displayName from ani_user_opus auo join ani_opus ao on ao.id = auo.opus_id and ao.is_deleted = 0 where auo.user_id = :userId and auo.last_episode_key is not null and auo.last_read_time is not null and not (auo.read_status = 1 and ((ao.media_latest_key is not null and auo.last_episode_key = ao.media_latest_key) or exists (select 1 from ani_user_opus_progress p where p.user_id = auo.user_id and p.opus_id = auo.opus_id and p.episode_key = ao.media_latest_key and p.is_completed = 1 and p.is_deleted = 0))) order by auo.last_read_time desc limit :limit
